reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event in November 2025
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00'
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event in November 2025
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
)
SELECT account_id, SUM(new_session) AS sessions
FROM flagged
GROUP BY account_id

WITH nov AS (
  -- one row per app event in November 2025
  SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts
  FROM app_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00'
)
SELECT e.account_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM nov e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM nov p
  WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id
    AND (p.event_ts < e.event_ts OR (p.event_ts = e.event_ts AND p.event_id < e.event_id))
    AND p.event_ts >= e.event_ts - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
)
GROUP BY e.account_id

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM nov p
  WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id
    AND (p.event_ts < e.event_ts OR (p.event_ts = e.event_ts AND p.event_id < e.event_id))

other_way.tradeoff: NOT EXISTS keeps the events with no earlier event of the user in the 30 minutes before, which reads well but runs slower than LAG.
